e893aaf338c45d97.title: To understand how social factors shape aging, we need to measure trajectories rather than states
digest: To understand how social disadvantage becomes biologically embedded, aging research must move beyond one-time assessments and instead track continuous, harmonized trajectories of health across the life course.

Measuring both peak attainment and rates of decline — and pairing these with dynamic social exposures — will reveal when and how inequities shape aging, and where intervention can have the greatest effect.

evidence.quote: To understand how social factors shape aging, we need to measure trajectories rather than states.

digest: Importance Bispecific antibodies targeting vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)/PD-1 ligand 1 (PD-L1) pathways represent a promising therapeutic strategy for advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

Design, setting, and participants This open-label, multicenter, phase 2 nonrandomized clinical trial enrolled patients with stage IIIB/C or IV NSCLC without sensitizing EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 alterations across 13 hospitals in China.

results.verbatim: In the nonsquamous cohort, confirmed ORR was 36.4% (95% CI, 17.2%-59.3%) and 57.1% (95% CI, 44.1%-69.5%) in the 10-mg/kg and 20-mg/kg dose groups, respectively.
In the squamous cohort, ORR reached 68.2% (95% CI, 45.1%-86.1%) and 74.2% (95%, 61.5%-84.5%) at the respective doses.

10f8f96b5b9c8b88.title: Single-cell multimodal atlas reveals regulatory programs in the human brain.
digest: Direct measurement of chromatin states together with transcription is essential for understanding how cell-type-specific regulatory programs are established and maintained in the adult human brain.
We targeted over 750,000 nuclei spanning 160 cell types and integrated these data with chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, 3D genome architecture, and spatial transcriptomes.

fc05f2b31ce5807b.title: Earlier Disclosure of Blood-Based Biomarkers, Diagnostic Certainty, and Clinical Management: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
digest: Design, setting, and participants This was a prospective randomized clinical trial conducted at a single memory clinic in Spain between February and October 2024, with 9 months of follow-up.

At 3 months, a very high-confidence etiologic diagnosis was achieved in 56 of 112 participants in the earlier-disclosure arm (50.0%) compared with 5 of 108 in the delayed-disclosure arm (4.6%) (P < .001).
Earlier disclosure was not associated with worse emotional outcomes.

evidence.quote: Importance Blood-based biomarkers show high performance for detecting Alzheimer disease (AD) pathology, but evidence on their impact on diagnostic certainty, clinical management, and emotional outcomes in routine care is limited.
Secondary outcomes included changes in clinical management and emotional outcomes (anxiety, depression, perceived stress, and quality of life).

digest: Productive engagement among older adults — which spans employment, volunteering and family caregiving — functions as a multidimensional driver of healthspan, economic stability and social cohesion across individual and societal levels.

673c8ed154243912.title: Sex and generation shape the genetic architecture of smoking initiation
digest: The rapidly changing cultural contexts over the past century modified the genetic factors that influence smoking initiation (SI).

Using data from nearly seven million respondents, we conducted genome-wide associations study (GWAS) meta-analyses stratified by sex and generation across European, East Asian, African American, and Latino genetic ancestry populations.
Specifically, SI is more heritable in females and younger generations.
